elements.label: Notion logo flashes (dims to grey and back) then cuts out

pattern.description: The Notion logo blinks (a quick dim-to-grey flash) and cuts to an empty frame; then the title 'Introducing' fades in grey and settles to black, followed by 'Notion' on a second line, building the product name word by word.
pattern.why_premium: The logo blink acts as a visual beat that hands off to type, and the same grey-to-black word settle used in the opening question keeps the typographic system consistent across the sequence.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to(logo, {filter: 'brightness(0.5)', duration: 0.07, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: 'steps(1)'}).set(logo, {autoAlpha: 0}).fromTo(words, {opacity: 0, color: '#8a8a8a'}, {opacity: 1, color: '#111', duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.25}).
build_hint.remotion: Logo: brightness toggles on two frames then unmounts (Sequence durationInFrames). Words in a later Sequence: per word i, start = i*8 frames; opacity = interpolate(f-start, [0, 4], [0, 1]); color = interpolateColors(f-start, [0, 9], ['#8a8a8a', '#111']); no spring.

notes: b01 is a diff box over the logo area at the start of the burst (logo not visible in end frame); b03 covers only the 'ion' part of 'Notion', which is the only candidate for that word. 'Notion' is still dark grey at the end frame, so its reveal continues past this event. The layout (Notion left-offset on line 2) suggests further words follow. No SFX candidates.
